procedure_text: Analogously to Comparative Example 1, a saturated solution of tembotrione in boiling ethyl acetate was prepared and cooled. In this manner, tembotrione was obtained in the form of crystalline prisms and platelets, which were isolated and analyzed by X-ray powder diffractometry (XRD). On the basis of the characteristic reflections, form B was identified.
procedure_summary: A saturated solution of tembotrione in boiling ethyl acetate is prepared and cooled as in the preceding comparative example, and the crystalline prisms and platelets that form are isolated and identified by X-ray powder diffractometry as form B.
